summary: Named as a Florida lookout in Santa Rosa County on the Eastern US Lookouts site; that page gives no build, height or fate details.

evidence.supports: Mulat is listed among the Florida lookouts
Mulat listing gives Santa Rosa County as its county

notes_for_editor: Very thin record. The only source is the Eastern US Lookouts Mulat page, which gives a name and county and nothing else. Two WebSearch queries (one aimed at TopoQuest) found no Mulat tower page; the Mulat Wikipedia article (fetched) has no mention of a tower, lookout or fire. The story is about 40 words, well under the 120-word floor. Recommend the editor hold it or accept it as a stub. The record's coordinates (30.5687, -87.1024) are not verified by any source I read.
